exec: pm.test("List includes all three created records", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.be.an("array"); const ids = body.map(function (item) { return item.id; }); [1, 2, 3].forEach(function (number) { const id = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("portalOpportunity" + number + "Id")); pm.expect(id).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(ids).to.include(id); }); });

pm.test("Correct record and complete details", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("portalOpportunity1Id"))); pm.expect(body.title).to.eql("Campus Network Performance Study"); ["description", "research_area", "faculty_name", "department", "required_skills", "positions_available", "application_deadline", "status", "created_at", "updated_at"].forEach(function (field) { pm.expect(body).to.have.property(field); }); });

pm.test("Changes returned and other fields preserved", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.title).to.eql("Updated Campus Network Performance Study"); pm.expect(body.required_skills).to.eql("Python, TCP/IP, Wireshark, and SQL"); pm.expect(body.positions_available).to.eql(4); pm.expect(body.research_area).to.eql("Computer Networks"); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql("Open"); });

body.raw: {"title":"Updated Campus Network Performance Study","required_skills":"Python, TCP/IP, Wireshark, and SQL","positions_available":4}

exec: pm.test("Status closed and prior update persisted", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("portalOpportunity1Id"))); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql("Closed"); pm.expect(body.title).to.eql("Updated Campus Network Performance Study"); pm.expect(body.positions_available).to.eql(4); });
pm.test("Deletion confirmation", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Research opportunity deleted successfully."); });
pm.test("Missing record error", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Research opportunity not found."); });

pm.test("Validation error format", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.detail).to.eql("Invalid request data."); pm.expect(body.errors).to.be.an("array").that.is.not.empty; });

pm.test("Blank, missing, position, and status errors identified", function () { const fields = pm.response.json().errors.map(function (error) { return error.field; }); pm.expect(fields).to.include.members(["body.title", "body.description", "body.positions_available", "body.status"]); });

if (step >= 5 && step <= 9) { const id = pm.collectionVariables.get("portalOpportunity1Id"); if (!/^[1-9][0-9]*$/.test(String(id))) { throw new Error("Run request 01 successfully before using this request."); } pm.variables.set("portalOpportunity1Id", String(id)); }
